title: IBM releases SOTA Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2 model with commercial-friendly license
summary: IBM has released Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2, a state-of-the-art foundation model for time series forecasting. Based on the PatchTST architecture, it is offered under a commercial-friendly license, making it suitable for enterprise deployment and integration into business applications without restrictive usage terms.
